name: Horoscopes
overview: Scripture clearly forbids engagement with horoscopes and related practices, warning against observing times or using enchantments as seen in Leviticus 19:26 and Deuteronomy 18:10. God commands His people not to seek out familiar spirits or wizards, emphasizing the severity of turning to such occult practices (Leviticus 19:31; 20:6). Additionally, the Bible warns against lifting one's eyes to the heavens to worship or serve the stars, which God has allotted to other nations, highlighting the danger of idolatry connected to celestial observation (Deuteronomy 4:19). This teaching underscores the call to trust in the Lord alone rather than divining the future through astrology or similar means.
